name: nivaran-ai
description: Nivaran AI - Single command runner for Backend and Frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix nivaran-frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix Backend start" "npm --prefix nivaran-frontend run dev"
scripts.build: cd nivaran-frontend && npm install && npm run build
